status: conditional exploratory extension after completing the three-dataset Pure PA and TLP comparisons
reason: Residual gamma=1.25 improves Pure PA at least on VOC21 and ADE20K, but Pure PA plus TLP remains below original PEARL on VOC20 and ADE20K. Test whether a small centered KK term adds value.
formula: softmax((QQ^T + gamma Q E^T + alpha Kc Kc^T)/sqrt(d))
first_stage: TLP off on all complete validation splits; alpha=0 is the historical gamma=1.25 result
second_stage: Only a development-set-supported alpha is considered for full TLP-on testing, using the Phase 3 fixed development partitions. Report all off results and any on results with the same full/holdout protocol.
interpretation: All alpha>0 variants are Residual-Enhanced PA+KK, not Pure PA. This follow-on is exploratory because Phase 3 full-split Pure PA and TLP results were inspected before planning it.
